claim_boundary: This is a local xTB command-semantics/source-capability screen on fixed water geometry, not a solvation accuracy, QM fidelity, force, PES, or total-solvation benchmark. It uses no experimental solvation value and does not preregister or validate a Route-2 candidate.

forbidden_followups: Do not zero or tune the surface tension, radius, dielectric, or other xTB internal term after this screen.
Do not use ALPB, GBSA, or CPCM-X as a Route-2 V0 accuracy shortcut; CPCM-X additionally contains CDS-type free-energy terms.
Do not use this one-water source screen as a chemistry or accuracy test.
decision.permitted_role: optional external empirical comparator outside the Route-2 V0 no-fit core, subject to separate protocol and labelling
why: The documented ALPB family is parameterized by solvent and includes Gsasa/Ghb terms.
With a numeric --cosmo dielectric, the local command still enabled GBSA and reported a nonzero Gsasa plus internal GFN-xTB/COSMO parameters, surface tension, density, and solvent mass.
Taking only reported Gelec would splice an implementation component out of the xTB stationary energy, violating the one-scalar ledger.
Keeping the full xTB gas-to-COSMO difference would introduce that preparameterized solvation model into the no-fit core and does not supply the required independent accuracy proof.

input.geometry: ASE G2 water geometry used by the archived scalar-response canary
